www.efsa.europa.eu en data data-standardisation .the implementation of efsa foodex2 facet term codes (ftc) in langual follow closely the efsa foodex2 codes; this means that the langual facet term codes for all foodex2 descriptors are identical to the original efsa foodex2 codes.efsa foodex2 is top-down prioritised, meaning that descriptors physically higher in the hierarchy within the same level are preferred to descriptors further down, whereas langual in general does not have a preferred order. in the implementation of efsa foodex2 it has therefore been necessary to implement a forced
